To support us in Berlin or Karlsruhe, we are looking for a Tax Specialist (f/m/d)  who wants to work across the full range of our tax topics and is keen to build expertise in transfer pricing.Tasks- Preparing tax balance sheets and tax returns for the German group companies together with our colleagues.- Support in preparing and maintaining our transfer pricing documentation (Master File, Local Files, CbCR), including functional and risk analyses.- Contributing to the implementation and further development of intercompany transfer pricing guidelines and models and reviewing intercompany agreements in coordination with the business functions.- Tax assessment of business transactions, contracts and restructurings.- Advising business functions and subsidiaries on tax matters, and acting as contact person for our foreign entities on operational questions regarding the operational application of transfer pricing requirements.- Supporting tax audits and communicating with tax authorities and external advisors.- Helping us develop our Tax Compliance Management System further and digitalise our tax processes.- Monitoring legislative changes and case law, and deriving recommendations for action.Qualifications- Academic track record with a finance and international tax background.- At least three years of professional experience in tax consultancy, audit, or an in-house tax function; experience in the tax department of a multinational group is an advantage.- German Tax Advisor Exam is an advantage.- Sound knowledge of German corporate income tax law; knowledge of international tax law is desirable.- Initial exposure to transfer pricing, or a clear interest in building expertise in this area.- Experience with SAP and common tax software, along with very good Excel skills.- Structured and independent way of working, and enjoyment of working with different business functions.- Business-fluent German and good English language skills.Benefits- Hybrid working model.- Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.- At some locations a subsidized canteen and various free drinks.- Modern office space with very good transport connections.- Various employee discounts for activities and products.- Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.- Numerous training and development opportunities.- Various health offers, such as sports and health courses.

jobs.occupation: Earth Observation (EO) & Remote Sensing Engineer (m/f/d) (Data Scientist)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Remote Sensing Specialists; Data Scientists; PhysicistsStellenbeschreibung:Earth Observation (EO) & Remote Sensing Engineer (m/f/d) Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available)  Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent)  Target Group: Remote Sensing Specialists, Data Scientists, Physicists, Opportunity Card Holders, and Master's Graduates  About Project IRIS Project IRIS develops AI-supported spatial resilience and geospatial data models for the energy transition. To breathe dynamic life into our static infrastructure data, we integrate global earth observation data into our central inference engine. In this role, you will add the dimension of real-time surface activity and physical states to our spatial intelligence models. Your Focus & Responsibilities - Satellite Pipelines: Build automated pipelines to fetch and process Sentinel-1 (Radar/InSAR) and Sentinel-2 (Multispectral) data via the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem. - Algorithm Development: Develop algorithms to automatically detect surface changes, vegetation decline, moisture indices (NDVI/NDWI), and thermal anomalies. - Data Integration: Seamlessly integrate derived raster metadata and Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs (COG) into our central PostGIS vector database. What We Are Looking For - Technical Background: Degree in Remote Sensing, Geoinformatics, Data Science, Physics, or equivalent practical industry experience.  - Core Technical Skills: Deep practical experience in processing satellite data (Landsat, Sentinel) using Python libraries such as Rasterio, xarray, or GDAL. - Mindset: An analytical mindset capable of deriving tangible ecological, thermal, and structural factors from raw pixel values. - Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates (Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card supported).  - Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); German language skills are a plus.  What We Offer - Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories.  - Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: Tailored tracks including academic coordination and complete tuition support.  - Accommodation & Onboarding Package: Structured assistance with local accommodation, official registration, and comprehensive onboarding.  - Visa & Administrative Backing: Dedicated employer support for Opportunity Card conversions and visa applications.  - Modern Tech Environment: Work in a high-efficiency environment focused on cutting-edge geospatial intelligence.  How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail:  jobs-geo@iris-institut.org (Subject: Application - Earth Observation Engineer)

jobs.occupation: Big Data & Backend Engineer – Spatial ETL (m/f/d) (Data Engineer)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Backend Engineers; Data Engineers; Database AdministratorsStellenbeschreibung:Big Data & Backend Engineer – Spatial ETL (m/f/d) Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available)  Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent)  Target Group: Backend Engineers, Data Engineers, Database Administrators, Opportunity Card Holders, and Master's Graduates  About Project IRIS Project IRIS is a proprietary applied research initiative processing massive amounts of infrastructure and spatial data. We bridge the gap between fragmented public data and actionable infrastructure intelligence. When standard APIs reach their limits and entire national registries must be processed, you step in. In this role, you are the architect for heavy data loads and robust backend pipelines.  Your Focus & Responsibilities - Bulk Processing: Automate the download and processing of massive data dumps (e.g., corporate registers, industrial emission databases like PRTR, energy grids). - ETL Engineering: Program high-performance ETL pipelines that decompress, parse, and transfer complex archives into our central PostgreSQL architecture. - Database Governance: Ensure idempotency, deduplication, and reliable monitoring during weekly multi-million row updates. - Container Orchestration: Deploy and maintain isolated Docker environments for all ingestion tasks.  What We Are Looking For - Technical Background: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or extensive practical backend industry experience.  - Core Technical Skills: Expertise in processing relational mass data, strong Python skills (SQLAlchemy, Pandas), and deep PostgreSQL performance tuning. - Mindset: A clean-code engineering approach focused on system stability and scalability.  - Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates (Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card supported).  - Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); German language skills are a plus.  What We Offer - Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories.  - Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: Tailored tracks including academic coordination and complete tuition support.  - Accommodation & Onboarding Package: Structured assistance with local accommodation, official registration, and comprehensive onboarding.  - Visa & Administrative Backing: Dedicated employer support for Opportunity Card conversions and visa applications.  - Modern Tech Environment: Work in a high-efficiency environment centered on Python, PostGIS, and Docker.  How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-trainee@iris-institut.org (Subject: Application - Big Data & Backend Engineer)

jobs.occupation: Municipal Data Mining & OParl Specialist (m/f/d) (Data Engineer)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Software Engineers; NLP Specialists; Data MinersStellenbeschreibung:Municipal Data Mining & OParl Specialist (m/f/d) Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available)  Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent)  Target Group: Software Engineers, NLP Specialists, Data Miners, Opportunity Card Holders, and Master's Graduates  About Project IRIS Project IRIS is an applied research initiative capturing and analyzing large volumes of public, unstructured text data from municipal information systems. By tracking local planning decisions before they hit official cadastral portals, we create early-warning systems for infrastructure development. In this role, you will build the automated agents that read and understand municipal government data. Your Focus & Responsibilities - API Integration: Develop and maintain Python-based interfaces to autonomously query municipal council information systems, primarily using the open OParl standard. - Document Parsing: Parse and structure extensive text documents, meeting minutes, and official zoning announcements (PDFs, HTML). - Text Mining & NLP: Apply regex, text mining, and fundamental NLP techniques to categorize administrative texts and extract spatial entities. - Data Harmonization: Clean and transfer the extracted, geocoded data into our central relational database architecture (PostgreSQL/PostGIS). What We Are Looking For - Technical Background: Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical industry experience.  - Core Technical Skills: Solid practical experience in Python, data extraction, API handling, and unstructured format processing (PDF, OCR, JSON). Familiarity with OParl is a strong advantage. - Mindset: A proactive problem-solving attitude with an eye for extracting structured truth from bureaucratic texts.  - Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates (Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card supported).  - Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); fluent or highly proficient German language skills are strictly required to accurately parse and interpret German administrative and legal texts. What We Offer - Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories.  - Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: Tailored tracks including academic coordination and complete tuition support.  - Accommodation & Onboarding Package: Structured assistance with local accommodation, official registration, and comprehensive onboarding.  - Visa & Administrative Backing: Dedicated employer support for Opportunity Card conversions and visa applications.  - Direct Mentorship: Close collaboration with experienced technical architects and executive leadership.  How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-scraping@iris-institut.org (Subject: Application - Municipal Data Mining)

Together with our commercial transfer network, we bridge the gap between academic data science, resilience research, and practical real-world application.
